title: Give infra (system-actions/vm-ops/deploy/diag/phone-executor-apk) preference on GitHub runner capacity over research and superseded CI
note: OPERATOR 2026-10-15 ~08:24Z verbatim: "generally we want to give infra preference on github capacity since the resaerch has its own dedicated resources"; also: let the current queue drain on its own -- NO manual cancels. TRIGGER/EVIDENCE (manager, 08:15Z): ~100 Actions runs queued (12 pytest-run, 11 pytest-rerun on superseded main shas, 10 Guards, 10 repo-inventory, 10 claude-pr-automerge, 9 pytest-collect ...) with research-queue-dispatch running on ubuntu-latest; phone-executor-apk queued 07:49Z finished ~08:20Z; system-actions runs 8472-8474 for an operator-approved live change queued 40+ min, one issue with no run at all; only 7 of 179 workflows set cancel-in-progress. SCOPE: (1) inventory research-*/ml-*/backtest workflows: compute-on-GitHub vs dispatch-only, measured durations; move heavy compute off GitHub runners. (2) concurrency + cancel-in-progress on PR CI (workflow + PR/head ref), pytest-rerun/workflow_run chains keyed on branch; never cancel main-push jobs that commit to main, deploy or run system-actions. (3) infra never queues behind research or superseded CI: measure what this plan allows (runner cap, research parallelism caps, self-hosted/trainer runners). LANE MEASUREMENT 08:21-08:30Z: 171 queued, 20/20 jobs in progress (Free-plan cap) = 12 pytest-run (PR, ~35-48 min each) + 5 Guards + 1 repo-inventory + 1 research-queue-dispatch + 1 live-replay-parity. Research held 1 of 20 slots; superseded/PR CI held 18. Inventory: comms/ci/gh-capacity-inventory-2026-10-15.json.  | SCOPE CORRECTION (operator ~08:25Z via manager, replaces scope (1)): not a migration but a PRIORITY ORDER -- research compute aims first at its dedicated resources (trainer VM, Kaggle, others); GitHub runners are spill-over only; infra (system-actions, deploy, vm-ops, diag relays, phone APK, PR CI on current heads) always first; research may use GitHub runners when free but must never make infra queue. BUILT: dispatch_queue.backpressure defers every research fire while any fresh run of research_compute.yaml limits.infra_workflows is QUEUED (tests in tests/test_research_backpressure.py). MEASURED caveat: every research backend workflow (trainer, kaggle, kaggle_cpu) holds a GitHub runner while it polls the remote job (loops up to 360 min), so dedicated-first does not by itself free GitHub slots; that needs fire-and-forget dispatch + collector (row GH-CAPACITY-RESEARCH-OFFLOAD, reframed). Class order already puts dedicated first where a unit can run there.
